findings.title: Own descendants after the direct process exits
findings.evidence: Independent harmless subprocess probe spawned a child that waited two seconds, inherited stdout, and then exited; its parent immediately printed valid PASS JSON and exited. capture_bounded(proc, 0.5) returned after 2.10 seconds with timed_out=false and validate_outcome accepted PASS. stop_owned_process returns immediately once the parent has exited, so descendants can also outlive a step or leave the reader blocked.
findings.required_change: Use bounded process-tree lifetime ownership that remains valid after direct-parent exit, including Windows. Enforce the timeout across process execution and output draining, terminate only owned descendants and verify cleanup before step completion. Cover exited-parent and inherited/closed-output descendant cases.

findings.title: Validate paths before effects and isolate cleanup failures
findings.evidence: Independent existing-fixture probe supplied first cleanup cwd='../' followed by a valid second cleanup. validate_plan accepted it; setup and scenario ran, the first cleanup raised before run_step's try, second cleanup never ran and lab-result.json was absent. invoke returned 2. Other exceptions outside the narrow catch, including process-tree cleanup failures, can likewise abort remaining cleanup.
findings.required_change: Resolve/validate every phase's cwd and executable/script inputs before starting setup. Normalize unexpected per-step failures into bounded outcomes; ensure each cleanup attempt is isolated so one failure cannot suppress later cleanup or the final FAIL evidence. Add regressions for invalid cleanup input and runtime cleanup exceptions.

findings.title: Enforce the documented direct-script-only shell contract
findings.evidence: Pure validation accepted ['powershell.exe','-c','Write-Output example'], ['pwsh.exe','Write-Output example'] and ['sh.exe','-c','echo example']. None was executed. PowerShell abbreviations/implicit command arguments and Windows shell executable suffixes bypass the current exact-token blacklist.
findings.required_change: Validate supported interpreter invocations as explicit reviewed script-file forms, rejecting inline/encoded/implicit commands and unsupported variants. Add accepted-script and rejected-command-form tests.
